payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute a 2D table v[i][j] of longest common suffix lengths. Use 1D DP over prefix lengths: dp[i] = min(dp[i-1] + a, min_{j} dp[i - t] + b) where t = min(i-j, v[j][i]).
payload.rationale: The optimization state is one-dimensional (prefix length). The 2D v table is an auxiliary precomputation for substring matching, not a DP state for the main cost minimization. Thus dp_1d_state best fits.
